plugin.name: geai
plugin.description: Autonomous debugging agent for IntelliJ IDEA. Describe a bug in the chat tool window and geai navigates the project, traces data flow, sets breakpoints, drives the debugger, and proposes or applies a fix in the project's style. Runs on an API key (Claude / DeepSeek / Qwen / OpenAI-compatible) or on your Claude subscription via the Claude Code CLI.
